items.title: Geometric reducedness at a point may be checked on the local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma, whose slogan is that geometric reducedness can be checked on local rings, identifies geometric reducedness of X at a point x with geometric reducedness over k of the local ring O_{X,x} (statement lines 355-367). The proof works in two directions that use genuinely different tools: for (1) => (2) one restricts to finite purely inseparable extensions, where Spec of the tensor product has the same spectrum and the base change has a unique point over x, and then applies the purely inseparable criterion for rings; for (2) => (1) one takes an arbitrary field extension and uses surjectivity of the base change together with the description of the local rings of X_{k'} as localisations of O_{X,x} tensor_k k' (proof lines 371-394). The step a reader cannot supply routinely is the identification of the local ring of the base change in the second direction, since it is a localisation rather than the tensor product itself. The claim is H2.
